rtl_framework.description: Preserve the six logical stages and precise commit boundary; optimize the owned DCache/load service without broadening issue width.

module_hierarchy.name: core_top
module_hierarchy.responsibility: Load queue ownership, active metadata replacement, scoreboard completion

module_hierarchy.name: dcache
module_hierarchy.responsibility: Pipelined hit service, critical-word-first refill, kill/drain, cache storage

module_hierarchy.name: dcache_data_bank
module_hierarchy.responsibility: Synchronous byte-write data storage suitable for BRAM inference

interface_ownership.protocol: single request ready plus pulsed response; response may coincide with next accepted request
one ID-less outstanding read, stable request under backpressure

clock_reset_cdc.reset_strategy: Existing active-high synchronous cpu_rst is preserved; cache valid/control reset, data bank not reset.

scaffold_direction.arithmetic: No ALU/MDU widening in this iteration.
scaffold_direction.control: Remove response-only DCache state and add refill_count/response_sent control.
scaffold_direction.interface: Allow response and next CPU request in one cycle without changing external dmem contract.
scaffold_direction.memory: Critical-word-first refill first; parameterized capacity second; synchronous BRAM bank before final timing run.

implementation_order.reason: Remove hit response bubble and add early restart.
Sweep cache capacity using the fixed 20M window.
Make data storage 200MHz-friendly and infer BRAM.

architecture_risks.risk: Response/request overlap can lose active metadata.
architecture_risks.mitigation: Explicit update priority plus directed back-to-back load regression.

architecture_risks.risk: Early response followed by flush may create duplicate or late completion.
architecture_risks.mitigation: One-shot response_sent state and kill/drain assertions.

architecture_risks.risk: Capacity increase may worsen timing despite IPC gain.
architecture_risks.mitigation: Use block RAM banking and decide from final routed timing.
